messages.subject: Interaction with smoother
parts:
Hello,

I am building up my model and had intended to include an interaction term. However one of the elements in the interaction would be best modelled by a circular smoother. Would it be possible to include an interaction with a smoother? If so, is the notation the same as between variables (i.e. *)?

Thanks
Suzanne

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Interaction with smoother
parts:
Hi,
The details for this depends on what you’re interacting it with. It’s probably easiest to make an f() model for the smoother, and combine it with your other variable via either replicate (iid model) or group (supports a few dependency structures).

Finn
